newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Tap says Tanami-1 well lifts oil output.
newsitem.headline: Tap says Tanami-1 well lifts oil output.

text.p: Tap oil NL said on Thursday the Tanami-1 oil well, located in the offshore Harriet Field of the Carnarvon Basin of Western Australia has been successfully worked over, increasing its production by 57 percent
The well had been shut in since March 1997 due to corrosion of the production tubing.
Prior to the shut down, the well was producing at a constant rate of around 580 barrels of oil a day (bopd) since output started on March 28, 1994, Tap said.
Production is now at a rate of 910 bopd, which should take total liquids production from the Harriet Field to around 10,000 bopd Tap said.
Tap, through its wholly owned subsidiary Tap (Harriet) Pty Ltd, holds a 12.2 percent in the Harriet Joint Venture.

The other partners are Apache Energy Ltd , (22.5 percent), Mobil Corp (25 percent), Kuwait Foreign Petroleum Exploration Corp (19.3 percent), Novus Petroleum Ltd (12.5 percent), Hardy Oil and Gas Plc (8.4 percent) and New World Oil and Developments Pty Ltd (0.1 percent). -- James Regan, Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
